headline_marked: [[300 tourists evacuated]] as fire breaks out at The Sea Princess Hotel in Cox's Bazar
headline: 300 tourists evacuated as fire breaks out at The Sea Princess Hotel in Cox's Bazar
summary: A fire erupted in the generator room of The Sea Princess Hotel in Cox's Bazar, prompting the swift evacuation of over 300 guests. Fortunately, no casualties or injuries were reported due to the quick response.
details: A fire broke out at The Sea Princess Hotel in Cox's Bazar's Sugandha Point on Friday afternoon, leading to the evacuation of over 300 tourists. The incident occurred in the generator room located in the ground-floor parking area.

The fire is initially believed to have originated from a short circuit in the generator. Upon receiving the report, a unit from the Cox's Bazar Fire Service and Civil Defense quickly arrived at the scene.

Hotel staff, who are part of a 20-member fire service-trained team, also responded immediately with fire extinguishers. The combined efforts brought the blaze under control within approximately half an hour.
While the generator and some parts of the parking area sustained damage, no casualties or injuries were reported among the tourists or staff. All guests were safely moved from their rooms.
This incident follows a recent fire on October 17 at TupTup Resort in Inani, Ukhia, which tragically resulted in the deaths of 10 tourists.
caption:

headline_marked: [[16 killed as 7.0-magnitude quake strikes remote Tibet region]] in China, dozens injured
headline: 16 killed as 7.0-magnitude quake strikes remote Tibet region in China, dozens injured
summary: China has launched an "all-out" rescue effort after a powerful 7.0-magnitude earthquake hit a remote area of Tibet, causing widespread damage and prompting the evacuation of over 12,000 residents.
details: China ordered an “all-out” rescue effort yesterday after a 7.0-magnitude earthquake killed at least 16 people and injured dozens more in a remote area of Tibet. The tremor struck on Thursday evening, prompting an urgent response from state authorities.

Footage showed rescue workers navigating through 339 houses that collapsed or were damaged. Xinhua reported that 76 people were injured, 11 seriously, and over 12,000 residents were evacuated following the 10:33 pm tremor.

Eyewitnesses described diners running out of restaurants and items falling from supermarket shelves. Residents, terrified by the shaking, rushed outside without time to dress, with many opting to sleep in tents or cars.

The earthquake's epicenter was in Baqing county, a sparsely populated area situated over 4,500 metres (14,800 feet) above sea level. This remote location is at least a 10-hour drive from the regional capital, Lhasa.

Hundreds of rescue workers, police, and over 300 soldiers were deployed with sniffer dogs and equipment to locate people under the rubble. Emergency personnel were seen carrying individuals and shining flashlights on damaged buildings with collapsed roofs.
